content: Polbaa-baŋ ciɛ kumaŋ Ikoniyɔmu‑i-na

Pol baa Barnabasi‑i baŋ kãa Ikoniyɔmu‑i-na, baa tiraa kã *Yuifu ba *Diilonelhãalãdũŋgu-na ka ta ba waŋ Diiloŋ-nelma‑i. Baŋ waŋ-maŋ dumaa, Yuifubaa-ba saa gbãa da ba yagar-ma baa *niɛraamba‑i. Ba bɔi baa hũyãa-ma.
Yuifubaa-ba maŋ saa hũu-ma, baa yaŋ aa kã ka gbo niɛraamba‑i baa Diiloŋ-dũŋ-baamba‑i.

Baŋ fiɛ gbo-ba, Polbaa-ba saa ta; baa tĩɛna da huɔŋgu Ikoniyɔmu‑i-na. Baa naa haa ba naŋga Itieŋo-na aa ta ba piiye. U taa u kãyã-bɛi ba ta ba ce nelma bɔi baa gbɛrɛ-wɛima bɔi a pigãaŋ wuɔ baŋ waŋ u ãnfafamma maŋ, coima sĩ.
Kuŋ ciɛ dumaaŋo-na, nuɔmba saa gbãa nunu ba-naa nelle-na: Banamba waa baa Yuifubaa-ba‑i, banamba waa baa Yesu *pɔpuɔrbiemba‑i.
Yuifubaa-ba‑i baa niɛraamba‑i a naara ba yuntaamba‑i, baa nunu ba-naa da ba bel Polbaa-ba‑i huol ba yammu‑i aa naŋ-ba baa tãmpɛ̃lɛ̃iŋa ko-ba.
Polbaa-ba nu-ma. Baŋ nuɔ-ma, baa gbar kã Likawoni ka ta ba waŋ *Neldɔdɔlma‑i. Ba waaŋ-ma Lisire‑i-na, baa Dɛrbu‑i-na baa nilɛiŋa maŋ kɔtɔnni-na hiere.
Mamaŋ ciɛ Lisire‑i-na
Naacolŋo naŋo waa Lisire‑i-na, u saa gbãa tuɔ sire u yiɛra. Uŋ siire, u saa gbãa tɛtɛŋ u gboluoŋgu‑i dede.
Yiiŋgu naŋgu-na, wuɔ tĩɛna tuɔ nu Pol tuɔ piiye. Pol wuɔ ji dĩŋ-yuɔ tuɔ ne, a ji da u suyaa wuɔ Diiloŋo gbãa sire-yuɔ u jarma-na.
Wuɔ piiye baa-yo da gbagaga wuɔ: «Sire ŋ yiɛra ŋ gbeiniŋ!» Naacolŋ wuɔ tie sire pãŋ tuɔ wuɔ.
Lisiretaambaŋ daa mafamma‑i, baa ta ba piiye likawonimma-na wuɔ: «I tĩnni cĩɛŋ nelbiliemba a hiire
jo ji tĩɛna baa-ye.»
Kuŋ ciɛ dumaaŋo-na, baa ta ba bĩ Barnabasi‑i Yewusi. Ba waa da ba cor kusuɔŋ-nu Pol yaa piiyeŋ, a ce dumaaŋo-na baa ta ba bĩ ufaŋo‑i Hɛrmɛsi.

Yewusi jigãntieŋ wuɔ kã ba nunu ba-naa baa nuɔmba‑i aa wuɔ bel balmba namba a tuɔlnu-bɛi jo baa-ba u tĩnniŋ-dũŋgu-na duɔ ji ko-ba tĩnni-na hã Pol baa Barnabasi‑i. U tĩnniŋ-dũŋgu waa nelle munsuurmu-na
Polbaa-ba saa suɔ ku yuŋgu. Baŋ juɔ suɔ, ba hɔmmu pãŋ guɔla; baa taalnu ba joŋgorbaa-ba‑i aa gbar kã ba wulaa ka ta ba waŋ baa-ba wuɔ:

«Na ce bige‑i maacemma‑i dumandɛ‑i-na? Caamba'i bi huɔŋ miɛŋo‑i namaa temma‑i. I juɔ baa *Neldɔdɔlma'i diɛ ji tũnu-nɛi, wuɔ na nanna ãnsɔsɔŋ daama‑i aa na cu Cicɛ̃lmantieŋo huoŋ-nu. U yaa hielaa dɔrɔ‑i baa hĩɛma‑i baa dãmmaŋ-nuoraaŋgu‑i baa ni huɔya-niini‑i hiere.
Yiinaa‑i-na, u yaaŋ nuɔmba‑i ba fɛrɛŋ nuɔ ba sire wuɔ ba hũmieŋa.
Naŋ fiɛ waa na fɛrɛŋ nuɔ, u saa yaŋ u ãnfafamma cemma‑i: U dãa u hã-na dii, u ce na dĩmma ta ma ce fafamma, u hã na ta na wuo na ye aa tiraa tuɔ fɛ̃ na hɔmmu‑i.»
Polbaa-baŋ fiɛ piiye dumaaŋo-na, nuɔmba saa ta ba ne da ba yaŋ niiŋ daaba komma‑i da ba hã-ba.

Ku huoŋgu-na, *Yuifubaa-ba namba ji jo; banamba hilaa Ikoniyɔmu, banamba hel Ãntiyɔsi maŋ Pisidi mara‑i-na. Baŋ juɔ, baa gbo nuɔmba‑i Polbaa-ba-na. Ba sire ta ba naŋ Pol baa tãmpɛ̃lɛ̃iŋa wuɔ ba ko-yo. Huɔŋgu naŋgu juɔ hi, ba da niɛ sĩ u kuu, baa bũul-o hel baa-yo nelle-na ka nanna.
Diiloŋ-dũŋ-baamba kã ka tigiiŋ u caaŋgu-na, wuɔ sire ba bir suur nelleŋ-huɔŋga-na. Polbaa-ba birii ta ba kã Ãntiyɔsi maŋ Siiri‑i-na Ku cuo kaala‑i-na, Pol wuɔ ta baa Barnabasi‑i ta ba kã Dɛrbu.

Baŋ kaa hi, baa waŋ *Neldɔdɔlma‑i baa Dɛrbutaamba‑i. Nuɔmba fɔ̃ŋgũɔ baa hũu-ma. Baŋ siire Dɛrbu‑i-na, baa bir kã Lisire‑i-na ka cor kã Ikoniyɔmu. Baŋ hilaa Ikoniyɔmu‑i-na, baa kã Ãntiyɔsi maŋ Pisidi mara‑i-na.

Ba waa da ba cor terieŋgu terieŋgu, ba ta ba piiye ba dii sirɛiŋa Diiloŋ-dũŋ-baamba-na wuɔ ba bel Yesu maama‑i nammu hãi. Aa bi ta ba piiye baa-ba wuɔ: «I saaya i mulĩɛŋ da dɛi aa suɔ diɛ suur *Diiloŋ-nelle‑na.»
Diiloŋ-dũŋ-baamba maŋ waa hiere nilɛiŋa faŋa-na, Polbaa-ba hiel yaataamba bɛi aa dii sũŋgu, aa cãrã Itieŋo‑i hã-ba, ba haa ba naŋga‑i u yaa nuɔ‑i.
Baŋ ciɛ mafamma‑i, baa sire karnu Pisidi mara‑i a kã Pãnfili mara nuɔ.
Baŋ kãa Pãnfili‑i-na, baa waŋ Diiloŋ-nelma‑i Pɛrge‑i-na, aa cor kã Atali
ka biɛ baatoŋo‑i ta ba kã Ãntiyɔsi maŋ Siiri‑i-na. Ba wuɔsaaŋgu duɔŋ kusuɔŋ-nu'i. Baŋ wuɔraaya ce mamaŋ daama‑i hiere, ba cãarã Diiloŋo‑i hã-ba kusuɔŋ-nu'i aa ba suɔ ta.

Diiloŋ uŋ kãayã-bɛi ba ce mamaŋ hiere, baŋ kãa ka hi, baa tigiiŋ Diiloŋ-dũŋ-baamba‑i hiere tũnu-bɛi baa-ma, aa uŋ bi kãayã *niɛraamba‑i dumaa ba hũu Yesu maama‑i, baa tiraa waŋ mafamma‑i baa-ba.
Baŋ ciɛ mafamma‑i, baa tĩɛna ce huɔŋgu baa-ba cɛllɛ.

footnotes.text: Girɛkibaa-ba wulaa, tĩnni waa bɔi. Ba tĩnni yuntieŋo yaa baŋ taa ba bĩ-yo Yewusi‑i, aa u pɔpuɔrbiloŋo‑i Hɛrmɛsi.
